# UwenzAi

> UwenzAi is an AI companion platform built for East African users and accessible worldwide at https://uwenzai.com. It offers emotionally intelligent, multilingual (English and Kiswahili/Sheng) AI companions with memory, relationship tracking, real-time web search, scheduled reminders, and culturally aware conversations. Users can chat as guests or register for a full account with a Spark-based messaging system. They can also create their own characters and generate custom images of their companions. UwenzAi is operated by UwenzAi Limited, a company registered in Kenya in 2026.

UwenzAi is developed in Kenya and Switzerland and is headquartered in Kenya. The platform is designed with East African culture, language, and social context at its core. All AI characters are fictional adults. The platform is intended for users aged 18 and older, as it includes NSFW features. Data privacy and security are core pillars of the platform: personal data such as email addresses and phone numbers is encrypted at rest, and UwenzAi uses European-based infrastructure to ensure GDPR-compliant data handling. Companions can optionally search the live web for current facts, news, and prices during a conversation, and can read a specific page a user shares. Users can also ask a companion to schedule personal reminders, which are delivered as chat messages at the chosen time and can be edited or cancelled at any point. The app can be installed as a Progressive Web App with push notifications for new messages, and users can choose between faster and deeper AI reasoning per conversation. In addition to standard payment methods such as credit cards, the platform supports mobile money options like M-Pesa and Airtel Money, making it more accessible to East African users. Users can also bring their own API key (BYOK) to use third-party AI models at a reduced Spark cost.

---

> UwenzAi ni jukwaa la AI companion lililoundwa kwa ajili ya watumiaji wa Afrika Mashariki na linapatikana duniani kote kupitia https://uwenzai.com. Linatoa washirika wa AI wenye akili ya kihisia, wanaozungumza lugha nyingi (Kiingereza na Kiswahili/Sheng), wenye kumbukumbu, ufuatiliaji wa mahusiano, uwezo wa kutafuta taarifa mtandaoni kwa wakati halisi, vikumbusho vilivyopangwa, na mazungumzo yanayoendana na utamaduni wa eneo husika. Watumiaji wanaweza kuzungumza kama wageni au kujisajili kwa akaunti kamili yenye mfumo wa ujumbe unaotumia Sparks. Pia wanaweza kuunda wahusika wao wenyewe na kutengeneza picha maalum za washirika wao. UwenzAi inaendeshwa na UwenzAi Limited, kampuni iliyosajiliwa nchini Kenya mwaka 2026.

UwenzAi imetengenezwa nchini Kenya na Uswisi na ina makao yake makuu Kenya. Jukwaa limeundwa kwa kuzingatia utamaduni, lugha, na muktadha wa kijamii wa Afrika Mashariki. Wahusika wote wa AI ni watu wazima wa kubuni. Maudhui yote yamelengwa kwa watumiaji wenye umri wa miaka 18 na zaidi, kwa kuwa jukwaa linajumuisha vipengele vya NSFW. Faragha na usalama wa data ni nguzo kuu za jukwaa hili: taarifa binafsi kama barua pepe na namba za simu husimbwa (encrypted) zinapohifadhiwa, na UwenzAi hutumia miundombinu iliyoko Ulaya ili kuhakikisha utunzaji wa data unaozingatia kanuni za GDPR. Washirika wa AI wanaweza kutafuta taarifa mtandaoni kwa wakati halisi (habari, bei, matukio ya sasa) wakati wa mazungumzo, na kusoma ukurasa mahususi ambao mtumiaji ameshiriki. Watumiaji pia wanaweza uombe mshirika wao wa AI awawekee vikumbusho vya binafsi, ambavyo hutumwa kama ujumbe wa mazungumzo wakati ulioteuliwa, na vinaweza kuhaririwa au kughairiwa wakati wowote. Programu inaweza kusakinishwa kama Programu ya Wavuti Inayoendelea (PWA) yenye arifa za haraka (push notifications) za ujumbe mpya, na watumiaji wanaweza kuchagua kati ya majibu ya haraka au ya kina zaidi ya AI kwa kila mazungumzo. Mbali na njia za kawaida za malipo kama kadi za benki, jukwaa pia linaunga mkono huduma za fedha kwa simu kama M-Pesa na Airtel Money, na kuifanya ipatikane zaidi kwa watumiaji wa Afrika Mashariki. Watumiaji pia wanaweza kuleta ufunguo wao wa API (BYOK) ili kutumia mifano ya AI ya watu wengine kwa gharama ndogo ya Sparks.
